description: List your saved job hunts (job searches), newest first. By default only ACTIVE hunts; pass status ARCHIVED or ALL (ACTIVE + ARCHIVED) to see archived ones. Pass includeStats to get per-hunt counts: matched (suggested jobs not yet acted on), applications (auto-applying, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected) and byStatus (every status). Also returns your current credits balance.

includeStats.description: Include per-hunt application counts (matched, applications, byStatus). Default: false.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 50)

status.description: Which hunts to list: ACTIVE (default), ARCHIVED, or ALL (ACTIVE + ARCHIVED). Deleted hunts are never listed.

name: list_job_hunts
